Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Devon Meadows

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Devon Meadows. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

Larger blocks, sheds and treed sites are part of the job in Devon Meadows, and we are used to roofs that need more than a quick once-over. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Devon Meadows: What We Commonly See

Devon Meadows is rural-residential country between Cranbourne and Pearcedale, a patchwork of market gardens, nurseries and acreage homes set among open paddocks. The homes here are typically on larger blocks, almost always with a shed, glasshouse or machinery building alongside the house. Set inland, the roofs deal with heat, harsh UV, the south-east's hailstorms and leaf litter rather than salt.

The jobs we are called out for most in Devon Meadows are refixing cracked ridge capping, storm and hail damage, clearing and replacing leaf-filled gutters, and re-roofing or re-sheeting larger home and shed roofs.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Devon Meadows

On larger blocks a roof is a bigger investment, and replacing one properly pays off for decades. We re-roof Devon Meadows homes, sheds and outbuildings in COLORBOND® steel, which is light, strong and low maintenance, and handles heat, wind and heavy leaf litter well.

Thinking about going metal? We also handle tile to tin conversions, swapping a heavy, high-maintenance roof for lightweight metal. If your roof has widespread leaks, sagging or badly rusted sheeting, talk to us about a re-roof before you keep paying for patch jobs. We will give you a straight answer on what makes the most sense for your home and budget.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Devon Meadows

Larger roofs and treed blocks put a lot of water and debris through the gutters. Our registered roof plumbers handle flashings, valleys, ridge capping, box gutters and downpipes, and can connect rainwater tanks and stormwater so the water ends up where it should.

Whether you need one section of guttering replaced or a full re-gutter with matching downpipes in COLORBOND® steel, we will quote it clearly and finish it neatly. Small jobs such as gutter repairs are no problem either.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Devon Meadows

Your quote depends on what your roof actually needs. Roof size, pitch and access, the type of steel and colour you choose, and how much plumbing work is involved are the main factors. We give you a clear written quote after an on-site inspection, so you know what you are paying for before any work starts.

Our Devon Meadows Roofing Process

It starts with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. Once you approve it we strip the existing roof, check and prepare the framing, then install new COLORBOND® steel sheeting, flashings and ridge capping, along with new guttering and downpipes where they are part of the job. Every job finishes with a clean site.

Why Devon Meadows Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

Devon Meadows locals choose Sandhurst Roofing because we turn up when we say we will, do quality work and charge a fair price. We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, and we explain what is happening every step of the way. Have a look at the COLORBOND® colour chart to start choosing your colour.

Devon Meadows Roofing FAQs

Do you work on sheds and outbuildings as well as the house?

Yes. We re-sheet and re-roof sheds, garages, stables and other outbuildings in metal, as well as the main house.

Can you fix gutters that fill with leaves and bark?

Yes. We replace overflowing gutters and valleys, and can fit systems that cope better with heavy leaf litter on treed blocks.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.
